subject.title: fix(agents): allow model fallback when takeover wrapper holds classifiable promptError

question: Should takeover-named cleanup wrappers with classifiable `promptError` bypass the pure-takeover abort and enter model fallback, or should that decision be handled only in the broader session-takeover PR?
rationale: The patch is technically focused, but it intentionally revises an existing session-state safety contract that current tests and the merged cleanup-takeover PR established.

options.title: Land the narrow fallback fix
options.body: Accept that a classifiable provider failure in `promptError` is the root cause and may proceed to the next configured model while pure takeover still aborts.

options.title: Fold into broader takeover work
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039 owns the same behavior with the broader session-takeover changes.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow fallback fix
recommendation.body: Accept that a classifiable provider failure in `promptError` is the root cause and may proceed to the next configured model while pure takeover still aborts.

likelyOwner.reason: They requested automerge on the merged PR that established the current takeover/fallback contract.
